notes.title: Slime Match Adventure Hotfix #1
notes.content: Minor patch with some optimization improvements and security. Change from mono compiling data to IL2CPP. Better performance in some cases. Reduced risk of cheating or tampering. Improved stability on modern platforms[img][/img]

notes.title: Demo Available Now!!!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627135/bb481c6a39b4b5ffa06a259d469d2837534ee358.gif"][/img][/p][h1]Slime Match Adventure Demo Now Available! [/h1][p][/p][p]The [b]Slime Match Adventure[/b] demo is now live on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Itch.io[/b]! It’s a small slice of the full game: 4 battles, 1 shop, and 1 wish. Designed to be completed in about 10 minutes—but it’s replayable![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794080/Slime_Match_Adventure_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Try it now and let us know what you think![b]  [/b]The full game launches [b]August 15[/b] on Steam 💚[/h3]
